timeline.description: Building advanced e-commerce platforms for large clients. Working with proprietary frameworks and frontend tools.
Developing web applications for an international cosmetics company. Optimizing performance and responsiveness of interfaces.
Building loyalty platforms and cashback applications. Integration with payment systems and partner APIs.
Specializing in Sylius e-commerce. Creating advanced online stores based on Symfony and modern frontend technologies.
Delivering projects for major brands (Bank Pekao S.A., PLAY, Emirates NBD). Working in an international agency environment.
Creating solutions for fashion and e-commerce industries. Projects for brands such as Marilyn, Tatuum, Cosmedica.
Developing a B2B platform for machinery and equipment industry. Working on frontend and backend, ERP system integrations.
Implementing Shopify Plus projects for international clients. Expanding store functionality and optimizing conversions.
Leading the frontend team. Developing an e-commerce platform with advanced features (video galleries, custom PDP). React, Next.js, TypeScript.
